description.text: The tenth expansion of the Sun & Moon series, released on 1 March 2019, with Reshiram & Charizard-GX on the wrapper; its GX attack can do 300 damage, ignoring any effects on the opponent's Pokémon. Muk & Alolan Muk-GX and Marshadow & Machamp-GX are its other TAG TEAMs, with Honchkrow-GX, Whimsicott-GX and Persian-GX and Supporters such as Welder, Red's Challenge and Giovanni's Exile. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 95, ending with four Trainer Rare cards marked TR, followed by full-art Super Rare cards, the TAG TEAMs in two versions each, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Fire Crystal, Shrine of Punishment and Triple Acceleration Energy. In English many of its cards came out in Unbroken Bonds in May 2019.
